en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 2.  It  is  narrated  from  Isa  bin  Abdullah  Alawi  who  has narrated from his father and he in turn from his father
that when  the  Messenger  of  Allah  (s.a.w.s.)  used  to  be  sad, Jibraeel (a.s.) used to come to him and say, “Do wash your head with jujube leaves.”
